title: fix: redirect old.pollinations.ai to pollinations.ai
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
`old.pollinations.ai` still serves the pre-migration site from Netlify, including the old Google Analytics tag (`G-LPZ9GEJVHR`). That is third-party tracking without consent, which our privacy policy rules out, and it keeps feeding a GA property we are retiring. Real visits there are rising (Cloudflare, bots excluded: 26 on 23 Sep → 957 on 27 Sep).

**Changes**
- `pollinations.ai/wrangler.toml`: adds the route `old.pollinations.ai/*` to the pollinations.ai Worker, so the Worker answers before Netlify is reached
- `pollinations.ai/src/worker.ts`: that hostname gets a 301 to `https://pollinations.ai/`
- `operations/app-management/app.json`: removes the "Ai Chatbot" entry (#6370), which listed `old.pollinations.ai` as a community app

**Verified locally**: `old.pollinations.ai/` and `old.pollinations.ai/p/…` → 301 `https://pollinations.ai/`; `pollinations.ai/apps` unchanged (200). `app.js validate` passes (877 apps).

**Deploy**: through the normal `Deploy / Cloudflare production` workflow after promotion. Afterwards the Netlify site and its DNS record can be deleted.

gist.headline: The old hive points home
gist.blurb: The old address now leads straight to the current site. Polli put up a sign; the Worker handles directions.
gist.summary: The Cloudflare Worker now returns a 301 from every old.pollinations.ai path to https://pollinations.ai/, and the outdated Ai Chatbot app listing has been removed.
gist.impact: Visitors using old.pollinations.ai links reach the current site instead of the pre-migration copy; the apps page continues to work as before.
gist.visual_concept: Show the old site as a small, vine-covered pixel doorway beside a bright path marked 301 leading to a welcoming current-site cottage. Polli, wearing a tiny guide's hat, points visitors down the path; a lime-green garden makes the destination feel like home.
